style.look: Painted storybook illustration of a place in a small medieval fantasy world, soft gouache with visible brush texture, muted natural colours, soft light and long soft shadows, hand-painted, one single full-bleed image with no fold, frame or border, no text, lettering, signature or watermark anywhere, wide landscape composition
style.keepOut: photorealism, 3d render, anime, neon colours, modern objects

parts.act1: Warm late-day light, earthy greens and straw golds, homely and lived-in
parts.act2: Clear daylight and richer colour, deep greens, warm reds and creams, a faint grey haze at the edges
parts.act3: Cooler, wilder light, colours a little drained, as if a sickness were creeping into the land
parts.act4: Cold, dim light, violet and grey shadows, colours drained almost to stone, a hush of dread

act1-abandoned-shed.text: A rickety shed stands precariously at the edge of Willowbrook, its weathered boards creaking in the wind. Rusty tools and broken crates are scattered outside, and a thick layer of dust covers everything. Little light gets past the grimy boards, and the air smells of old earth and lamp oil. the door is bolted shut. there are cat tracks outside.
act1-abandoned-shed.gameWas: A rickety shed leans precariously at the edge of Willowbrook, its weathered boards creaking in the wind. Rusty tools and broken crates are scattered about a long workbench, and a thick layer of dust covers everything. Little light gets past the grimy boards, and the air smells of old earth and lamp oil.

act1-blacksmiths-forge.text: A hot, smoky forge. Coals glow in the hearth and the anvil rings. Hinges, ploughshares and horseshoes hang from the walls, waiting to be mended or fetched, and the blacksmith is working on a sword in the forge with a hammer.
act1-blacksmiths-forge.gameWas: A hot, smoky forge. Coals glow in the hearth and the anvil rings. Hinges, ploughshares and horseshoes hang from the walls, waiting to be mended or fetched, and the blacksmith wipes his brow without putting down the hammer.

act1-forest-path.text: A winding path snakes into the heart of the woods, dappled sunlight flickering through the canopy above. A section of the path is blocked by thick, thorny vines. The air is alive with the scent of pine and wildflowers, and the ground is soft with moss and fallen leaves. A bird flit between branches, and the occasional snap of a twig hints at unseen creatures nearby.
act1-forest-path.gameWas: A winding path snakes into the heart of the woods, dappled sunlight flickering through the canopy above. A section of the path is blocked by thick, thorny vines. The air is alive with the scent of pine and wildflowers, and the ground is soft with moss and fallen leaves. Birds flit between branches, and the occasional snap of a twig hints at unseen creatures nearby.

act1-general-store.text: A well stocked shop with the shutters half down. Rope, apples, matches and weapons are lined up neatly in the shelves in the gloom. There are price tags on everything. The shopkeeper stands by the shelves, stacking apples.
act1-general-store.gameWas: A cluttered shop with the shutters half down. Rope, apples, matches and trinkets crowd the shelves in the gloom. The shopkeeper stands at the window, watching the lane.

act1-hidden-glade.text: A hushed clearing hidden deep within the forest, dim and overgrown. Brambles crowd its edges, and the tall grass stands grey and still beneath branches that shut out the sun. In the center, a mossy boulder stands. An unnatural darkness lingers here, though the sky above the branches is clear.
act1-hidden-glade.gameWas: A hushed clearing hidden deep within the forest, dim and overgrown. Brambles crowd its edges, and the tall grass stands grey and still beneath branches that shut out the sun. In the center, a mossy stone bears a faint inscription, too deep in shadow to read. An unnatural darkness lingers here, though the sky above the branches is clear.

act1-miras-hut.text: The inside of a small hut hung with drying herbs: lavender, sage, and roots in bundles from the rafters. Shelves of bottles line the walls, every one labelled. Mira, the mysterious healer, a middle aged woman, moves among them without looking, the way you move through your own kitchen.
act1-miras-hut.gameWas: A small hut hung with drying herbs: lavender, sage, and roots in bundles from the rafters. Shelves of bottles line the walls, every one labelled. Mira moves among them without looking, the way you move through your own kitchen.

act1-old-mill.text: A creaky windmill towers above, its sails turning slowly in the breeze. The scent of flour hangs in the air. Sunlight illuminates sacks of grain and a heavy millstone. The door to the mill is ajar and nside the mill, you notice a strange mechanism of black iron, whirring to itself, that doesn't belong to the mill's original design.
act1-old-mill.gameWas: A creaky windmill towers above, its sails turning slowly in the breeze. Dusty gears and cobwebs fill the interior, and the scent of flour hangs in the air. Sunlight streams through broken windows, illuminating sacks of grain and a heavy millstone. Amidst the old workings, you notice a strange mechanism of black iron, whirring to itself, that doesn't belong to the mill's original design.

act1-portrait-deer.text: A face portrait of a red-brown deer, its dark eyes calm and unafraid and its ears turned toward you. The deer is standing in the middle of a forest.
act1-portrait-deer.gameWas: A face portrait of a red-brown deer, its dark eyes calm and unafraid and its ears turned toward you.

act1-portrait-dream-voice.text: A face portrait of a cloaked man but the face is hidden and you can only see a siluette. The background is a stormy night with thunder and lightning.
act1-portrait-dream-voice.gameWas: It has no face you can find, only a height and a nearness. When it speaks, it speaks your name.

act1-portrait-grandmother.text: A face portrait of your grandmother.
act1-portrait-grandmother.gameWas: Your grandmother, flour on her apron and her sleeves pushed up. She has raised you since your parents went away, and she keeps her hands busy when she would rather not answer.

act1-riverbank.text: A gentle river flows past the village and makes a slow bend here, past the reeds and a broad, flat stone at the water's edge. A weathered fisherman sits on an upturned crate at the bend, his line in.
act1-riverbank.gameWas: A gentle river flows past the village and makes a slow bend here, past the reeds and a broad, flat stone at the water's edge. Insects hum over the water. A weathered fisherman sits on an upturned crate at the bend, his line in.

act1-road-to-greendale.text: The main road out of Willowbrook runs east under old oaks, their branches meeting overhead. The way is well trodden, lined with wildflowers and fallen leaves. A merchant's cart stands beside the road.
act1-road-to-greendale.gameWas: The main road out of Willowbrook runs east under old oaks, their branches meeting overhead. The way is well trodden, lined with wildflowers and fallen leaves. A merchant's cart stands at the roadside, and his thin grey mare grazes beside it on three good shoes.

act1-the-dream.text: It is dark, and it is raining hard. In the clouds, you can see the outlines of a cloaked man. You hear it beating on shutters, though you cannot see any. Thunder breaks so close that the dark shakes with it. Shadows drift past like smoke. A man’s hand reaches out of the dark, lifts a child and holds it against his shoulder, and then both of them are gone. Somewhere a slow tune climbs three notes and settles home again. A tall figure stands among the shadows. It has no face you can find. It is too far away to reach, and too close to be only a dream. It is whispering, at the very edge of hearing, and what it whispers is your name.
act1-the-dream.gameWas: It is dark, and it is raining hard. You hear it beating on shutters, though you cannot see any. Thunder breaks so close that the dark shakes with it. Shadows drift past like smoke. A man’s hand reaches out of the dark, lifts a child and holds it against his shoulder, and then both of them are gone. Somewhere a slow tune climbs three notes and settles home again. A tall figure stands among the shadows. It has no face you can find. It is too far away to reach, and too close to be only a dream. It is whispering, at the very edge of hearing, and what it whispers is your name.

act1-vegetable-field.text: Rows of withered wheat plants stretch beneath a brooding gray sky. The earth is cracked and dry. A  couple of rotten carrots and a rusty hoe Is laying on he ground. A faint breeze rustles the brittle leaves, carrying the scent of soil and distant rain. These rows were green a month ago.
act1-vegetable-field.gameWas: Rows of withered crops stretch beneath a brooding gray sky. The earth is cracked and dry, with only a few stubborn carrots and a rusty hoe hinting at better days. A faint breeze rustles the brittle leaves, carrying the scent of soil and distant rain. These rows were green a month ago.

act1-village-square.text: The heart of Willowbrook, a medieval village: cobblestones around an old stone fountain, and a weathered notice board covered in faded announcements. The text is unreadable. Half the market stalls stand empty. The people at the others keep their voices down, and stop talking when you pass. All the people are dressed in medieval clothes. No one is wearing a hat.
act1-village-square.gameWas: The heart of Willowbrook: cobblestones around an old stone fountain, and a weathered notice board covered in faded announcements. Half the market stalls stand empty. The people at the others keep their voices down, and stop talking when you pass.

act1-village-well.text: An old stone well stands between the field and the forge, its stones worn smooth by countless hands. The water below lies dark and still. Moss creeps up the sides.
act1-village-well.gameWas: An old stone well stands between the field and the forge, its stones worn smooth by countless hands. The water below lies dark and still, and a faint sour smell hangs in the cool, damp air. Moss creeps up the sides.

portrait-mira.text: A face portrait of a village female healer in middle age, with a calm, steady gaze that rests on you a moment longer than is comfortable, and a sprig of dried sage tucked behind one ear.
portrait-mira.gameWas: A face portrait of a village healer in middle age, with a calm, steady gaze that rests on you a moment longer than is comfortable, and a sprig of dried sage tucked behind one ear.
